content: Cross-strategy / cross-asset correlation monitoring exists in institutional and portfolio-analytics products (concentration, correlation, volatility, ETF overlap with threshold alerts; heat maps, cluster plots, network graphs) but was NOT found as a feature of any retail crypto bot or AI-first trading platform. The specific framing 'you are running five strategies that are all one long-BTC-momentum bet at 5x size' appears unoccupied in this category.
